info.name: Restful Booker API
info.description:
Automated Postman API test suite for Restful Booker (https://restful-booker.herokuapp.com/apidoc/index.html).

Configured with dynamic booking variables (Jim Brown, 111, true, 2018-01-01, 2019-01-01, Breakfast) with pre-request resolution, dynamic token chaining, and automated assertions across the 8 core endpoints.
